title: The King in the Labyrinth
subtitle: Is it a monster––or the king's greed––that is imprisoned in the labyrinth of Daedalus?

items.text: The King in The Labyrinth

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: Come now, if we don't tell them, there will be no escaping.

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: I just don't get it.

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: These things bring joy to everyone. So why does he want to take them away?

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: I—I can't wrap my head around it.
The laughter around them subsided, and worried expressions began to replace smiles on the faces of the troupe.
All turned up to Charlie as if realizing something.

items.speaker: Troupe Member I
items.text: Charlie... What's happened?
But as Charlie opened her mouth, not a squeak emerged.

items.speaker: Troupe Member II
items.text: We're ready, Troupe Master.
But before she could speak, Jeffrey rushed in, panting heavily.

items.speaker: Jeffrey
items.text: Troupe Master Charlie! Why aren't you ready to go? The cavalry... they're almost upon us!

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: So, my dear, what's holding you back?

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: Anxiety? Anger? Or just plain terror?
The clown stepped onto the stage—earlier than any of the others.
Behind that comical mask lay a heart stronger than any other.
He had made his decision already.

items.speaker: Jeffrey
items.text: We have to go now, Troupe Master!

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: Why... why does he want to take it all away?

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: —Have you heard the tale of Minos?

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: The tale of Minos?

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: Yes, the tale of that famous king.

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: When the Greek prince Minos vied for the throne, he sought divine favor to prove himself the rightful king.

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: "Oh, gods," he prayed, "if you support me, grant me a white bull."

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: "Then, I will sacrifice it in your honor—this shall be our pact."

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: The gods answered, granting him a white bull.

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: But greed led Minos to deceive them.

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: He sacrificed a different bull, claiming the white one for himself.

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: But though Minos had kept the white bull, he soon lost what he sought most, no longer was he a king recognized by all.

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: The term "tyrant" suited him better.

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: Tyrant...

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: Those who play the role of a tyrant. should understand better than anyone—the nature of "him".

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: A tyrant is a monster, a towering creature.

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: ...Unbound to his duty, unstoppable in his wrath.

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: A tyrant scorns all, seeking only power.

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: ...He is greedy, hungry to devour everything in sight.

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: But his arrogance will bring him crashing down. For fear cannot withstand mockery.

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: Then, the once-terrified populace will rise, and a new king will lead them.

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: So, have you made your choice—run or stand? Live in fear or laugh in the face of death?

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: Run or stand...

items.speaker: Jeffrey
items.text: Hold on, Mr. Fool, do you mean...

items.speaker: Jeffrey
items.text: No! That's too risky!

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: It seems you've made up your mind, Troupe Master Charlie.

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: You're right, Mr. Fool; I have.

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: I do not know what day the tyrant will fall, but until then, it's our duty to resist.

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: Is our show ready?

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: All the players wait for your cue, Troupe Master.
The Fool bowed his head, acknowledging her command.
Charlie closed her eyes. Reopening them with a phoenix heart, ready to begin.

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: Let the show go on!

items.speaker: Jeffrey
items.text: Troupe Master Charlie! Don't be reckless!

items.speaker: Jeffrey
items.text: The rest of the citizens at the festival are under the Mayor's protection, and the cavalry have no right to harm them.

items.speaker: Jeffrey
items.text: But your troupe are outlaws! They are authorized to kill you on sight!

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: This is far from recklessness.

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: Troupe Master Charlie made her decision long ago. She only needed a gentle nudging from The Fool.

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: There's no need to fear.

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: Even if the tyrant brings death, we'll not stay idle in our graves!

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: Should death kiss us lightly on the cheek, our struggle will be our epitaph.

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: But before that—

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: We'll mock the tyrant as he deserves.

items.speaker: Troupe Member I
items.text: We're ready, Troupe Master. the stage is set and the players have their mark!

items.speaker: Troupe Member II
items.text: We've been running for so long, but that doesn't mean we'll keep running forever.

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: Looking upon this grand finale, where would the excitement be to flee?

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: Marvelous.

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: Give your best performance, and let the audience witness our struggle with their raucous applause.

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: We've fled from battlefields, gallows, palaces, dungeons, and we could keep fleeing.

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: But we performers owe our audience a masterful performance, no matter the circumstances...

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: —That is our promise to them.

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: We shall be Theseus, not Minos who tramples on his promise.

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: Mr. Fool, ring the bells to announce the start of our show to the audience!

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: —And, of course, don't forget to invite our "special guests."
TO BE CONTINUED ...
